svg.title: Waymark
svg.desc: Waymark: India-first travel discovery and trip planning. A wireframe of the Western Ghats turns on a turntable while three pins and a dashed route ride on it; glass cards show the featured Coorg escape and an estimated trip budget. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
svg.text: Discover India by mood, region and collection,
then plan it: an editable itinerary, a map of
places and a budget in ₹, clearly an estimate.
